title: HATEPRISM: Policies, Platforms, and Research Integration. Advancing NLP for Hate Speech Proactive Mitigation
findings: The paper found that only 3% of the 38 surveyed hate speech dataset research papers mentioned the religion of the annotators, highlighting a lack of consideration for this demographic factor in dataset creation. It also notes the development of tools to specifically counter 'Islamophobia'.
